body:
The private FP32 estimate candidate completed one ordinary-driver/JIT screen. Its **COST_PREMISE_SURVIVES_UNPROVEN** result is preserved in the [immutable 166-file bundle](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/0ed71524fab1974f597ecc96d35c2dced512bb96/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-ordinary-jit-screen/result.json). No arithmetic or benefit trial was run for this FP32 profile, and there is no adoption or qualification.

The single owned capture passed in 20.658 seconds at 1,733,980 KiB peak sampled RSS, under the original 300s/4GiB/2GiB governors and cache-off policy. All 933 static pins and 939 before/after/current inputs matched. The unchanged canonical host was reused without rebuilding or recapturing stock. Fresh raw 55-field device arguments enabled only canonical unused Float64, with Int64 disabled; the loaded shader itself requires only 32-bit arithmetic. Successful module loading, the two original LLVM pipelines, exported IR/generation/lookup and called cs_variant were joined to all six allocated native sections, 5,311 absolute plus four PC64 relocations and uncovered bytes. Actual-call loader/LVP/LLVM mappings match the same owned inferior birth, device and inode. Undefined callbacks were checked for consistency only. The original one-word canary refuses before retained arithmetic.

The [actual code/cost review](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/0ed71524fab1974f597ecc96d35c2dced512bb96/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-ordinary-jit-screen/files/out/portable-divide-fp32-estimate-jit/cost-review/cost-premise-review.json) traces all six Divide clones. Each of four SIMD8 sites contains eight scalar corrective divides and can skip the original 32-divide fallback packet; each scalar site has one versus four. A mixed vector group can pay both packets. All 191 original native integer divides remain statically, with 34 new corrective divides and six float estimate sites. Text grows 8,448 bytes, the coroutine frame 448 bytes and fixed native stack reservation 192 bytes. Five whole-object calls and two LLVM allocas remain unchanged. These are static path and size observations, with no hit-rate or speed claim.

The new archive also contains the exact selected stock comparison closure: all 33 raw capture files, matching compile/link/capture ownership and recovery payloads, and the two canonical producer files. Those selected bytes are now remotely preserved; the entire older multicapture archive is not claimed as backed up. A copied audit-receipt nanosecond timestamp was corrected to the exact raw integer without changing or rerunning the capture.

Next is a separate source prototype replacing the corrective division with five exact binary correction steps. The existing guard proves residual < 32*divisor, so the five-bit quotient and remainder can be reconstructed using bounded uint32 comparisons/selections/subtractions. Its actual lowering and cost remain to be checked. The original prefix, complete fallback, rounding and all original arithmetic/integrated/20+2 benefit gates remain required before any adoption; this is not a failed benefit verdict for the screened candidate.

All 96 completed private JIT source/product files were retired after exact pushed-archive inventories and fresh recorded-birth absence checks. Canonical 4498cc41168ad29fc4c111819a4cb7ccaa54a8bf remains clean, committed and pushed on development/minimum-step-floor-2026-10-15 with one worktree. This issue and the ultimate qualification goal remain open.
